cataloged_datasets.name: NASA SRTM 1 Arc-Second Global Elevation (SRTMGL1 v003)

cataloged_datasets.name: Copernicus Digital Elevation Model GLO-30
cataloged_datasets.blockers: Requires AWS S3 / Planetary Computer public bucket access script or ESA Copernicus portal download.

cataloged_datasets.name: ISRO Bhuvan CartoDEM 30m Version 3R1
cataloged_datasets.blockers: Requires OTP-authenticated Bhuvan user credentials; bulk API downloads restricted.

cataloged_datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Yamuna Corridor Waterways & Embankments
cataloged_datasets.blockers: Requires clipping India / Northern Zone OSM extract to corridor bounds.

cataloged_datasets.name: Delhi Master Plan Zone-O (River Yamuna Floodplain Demarcation)
cataloged_datasets.blockers: Official GIS shapefile restricted across municipal agencies; published predominantly as static PDF plans.
